summary.one_liner: A native macOS chess app that lets you play two-player games on a board and analyze games with the Stockfish engine or any UCI engine.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a chess board with animated piece moves, legal move highlighting, and a best-move arrow. It can interface with any UCI chess engine and is powered by the open-source Stockfish engine. It supports opening, viewing, and saving multi-game PGN files, and copying and pasting FEN strings. It offers MultiPV, undo/redo, and some UCI options. At startup it detects system hardware to load the 64-bit, SSE4.2, or Haswell engine binary.
use_cases: analyze chess games on a Mac
play two-player chess on a board
run a UCI chess engine with a graphical interface
copy and paste chess positions as FEN
how_to_run: Download from the Mac App Store (link in README)
stack: Objective-C/Swift (macOS app, inferred from Mac App Store distribution)
notable: Accepts any UCI chess engine, not just Stockfish
Auto-selects 64-bit, SSE4.2, or Haswell engine binary based on hardware detection
Reuses source code from Tord Romstad's Stockfish for iOS app
caveats: README does not state a price; distribution is via the Mac App Store link
Features not present are tracked as open issues in the issue tracker
